text: Escalate a ticket to a human specialist when ANY of these are true: (1) the customer makes a legal threat or mentions a lawyer, regulator, or lawsuit; (2) there is a security or data issue — breach, unauthorized access, data loss, or exposed credentials; (3) there is churn risk on an account worth more than $5,000 ARR; (4) the customer has made 3 or more contacts about the same issue without resolution. When in doubt on a high-value account, escalate rather than guess.
